name: airy[F]airy ~Easter of Sant' Ariccia~
source:
There is a large sacred tree in Alicia Forest near the village of Nemi. Once every year it’ll glow and if a couple vows to love each other under its glow, they will live happily ever after. Elmo is preparing for the the annual Easter of Sant’Ariccia festival. His adoptive father disappeared 3 months ago and he had to take over the graveyard duties. Every Tuesday midnight, he has to participate in the battle of ‘Eremita’. If he loses, Tuesday will be stolen from this world.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/11/01/november-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
涅米村附近的艾丽西亚森林里生长着一棵巨大的神圣古树。每年，它都会发光一次。传说情侣若在光芒下立下相爱誓言，便能永远幸福地生活。艾尔莫正在为一年一度的圣阿里恰复活节做准备。养父三个月前失踪，他只能接手墓地管理工作。每周二午夜，他还必须参加“Eremita”之战。一旦失败，星期二便会从这个世界上消失。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/11/01/november-2009-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
